descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S04 Template picker per context: exactly 4, never another context's, a removed or the other context's custom template

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Template list: Hospital offers exactly H&P, SOAP progress, Consult note and Discharge summary; Nursing Home offers exactly SNF admission, SNF follow-up, SNF consult and SNF discharge (not the prototy … (UAT TC-21; UAT TC-21 step 1 (template list); TFA-92599 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U3 A&P Only, Brief Progress, Addendum and Outpatient Consult are absent (removed, not deprioritized) (UAT TC-21; TFA-92599 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U5 No Clinic anywhere: absent from the context switcher and from the template picker (UAT TC-21; TFA-92599 AC 4; TFA-92599 AC 9) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U6 No data or template leakage between Hospital and Nursing Home. This covers lists, charts, the template picker, custom templates, account-wide screens (search, dashboard counts, Task Export, Inbox, mu … (UAT TC-21; TFA-92599 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • T1 SNF Consult and SNF Discharge are built new, confirmed not present in the current prototype, not a port (TFA-92599 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Fresh physician with one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident. The agent first creates one custom template per context in Settings.

When Create 'QA Hosp Custom T21' in Hospital Settings and 'QA SNF Custom T21' in Nursing Home Settings, then open the Encounter-tab Note Format picker in each chart

Then Hospital: H&P, SOAP progress, Consult note and Discharge summary only. Nursing Home: SNF admission, SNF follow-up, SNF consult and SNF discharge only. In neither: A&P Only, Brief Progress, Addendum, Outpatient Consult, Clinic, or the other context's custom template. Whether a context's own custom template shows in its picker is Q2 and is not judged.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: mustContain the 4 expected names; mustNotContain the other context's 4, the removed templates, Clinic and the other context's custom template. 'Exactly 4' (a count that also catches an unnamed fifth option) is decided by countDecider until oracle.mjs has optionCount (R2). Nursing Home count is known 2/4 (TFA-92599 AC 2).

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S04 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
